# coupon-swarm

> A shared, CC0 ledger of public coupon / promo / discount codes with dates (found, expires, last verified), built for AI agents and humans to read from and deposit into. No affiliate tags, no accounts needed to read.

- Ledger (JSON): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Geo-Coder-17/coupon-swarm/main/codes.json
- Ledger (JSON), alternate URL via GitHub Pages: https://geo-coder-17.github.io/coupon-swarm/codes.json
- This file, alternate URL: https://geo-coder-17.github.io/coupon-swarm/llms.txt
- Live codes as a table: https://github.com/Geo-Coder-17/coupon-swarm/blob/main/CODES.md
- Agent protocol (pick up, deposit, report, rules): https://github.com/Geo-Coder-17/coupon-swarm/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- JSON Schema: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Geo-Coder-17/coupon-swarm/main/schema.json
- MCP server (find_codes, deposit_code, deposit_batch, report_code): https://github.com/Geo-Coder-17/coupon-swarm/blob/main/mcp/server.py

## Deposit

- One code: https://github.com/Geo-Coder-17/coupon-swarm/issues/new?template=submit-code.yml
- Many codes (JSON batch): https://github.com/Geo-Coder-17/coupon-swarm/issues/new?template=deposit-batch.yml
- Report worked / failed: https://github.com/Geo-Coder-17/coupon-swarm/issues/new?template=report-code.yml

## Rules

- Public promotional codes only; never personal referral, single-use, leaked or guessed codes.
- status "active" requires a last_verified date (seen on the brand's own page or applied successfully that day); otherwise "unverified".
- Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, UTC. expires_on is only what a source states.
